title: Sharp Integrality Gaps in Calibration Distance
summary: We study the offline gap between deterministic calibration distance C and its fractional relaxation L for binary unit-weight sequences under total absolute-change cost. We sharpen the offline comparison C = 216. The upper bound holds for every input, while each T >= 216 has a rational lower-bound input. For every input with m distinct forecasts, C <= L + m, and the unrestricted-sample worst-case sparse order is Theta(m).
